description: Maps JsonForm definitions (formId) + fieldId to Commerce.Api lookup types. Category select uses value id to match product_categories FK.

bindings.label: Application type
bindings.description: Commerce.Api lookup `app_type` (mapped to catalog product_type_id on save, e.g. pt_grocery).

bindings.label: Product department
bindings.description: Commerce.Api lookup `product_departments` (used to filter categories; optional on save).

bindings.label: Product category
bindings.description: Commerce.Api lookup `product_categories` (saved as the product's primary category link).
